say:1:1520633001:1.text: I see him! He's over there, under a dead tree!
say:1:1520633001:1.source_cn: 我看到了！马修在远处那棵枯树树下！

say:3:1520633003:1.text: I doubt he ran over there on his own...
say:3:1520633003:1.source_cn: 他恐怕不是自己跑过去的……

say:4:1520633004:1.text: See <style="highlight">that hawk moth under the tree</style>? That thing is vicious, and it can call for backup. Trust me, you don't want to see the sky filled with them.
say:4:1520633004:1.source_cn: 你们看到<style=highlight>那树上的鹰蛾...

choice_prompt:5:1520633004.text: See <style="highlight">that hawk moth under the tree</style>? That thing is vicious, and it can call for backup. Trust me, you don't want to see the sky filled with them.
choice_prompt:5:1520633004.source_cn: 你们看到<style=highlight>那树上的刁彩羽鹫</style>了吧？那家伙凶猛得很，还会用叫声呼唤同伴，你们绝对不想看到天空中布满了这种鸟的场景。

say:6:1520633006:1.text: One of my soldiers stumbled into Dregwood once. He said there are <style="highlight">spiky coconuts</style> growing here. The hawk moths love them. We could use the coconuts to <style="highlight">lure it away</style>.
say:6:1520633006:1.source_cn: 我手下的一位士兵也曾误入这里，他说水淀枯林中长有<st...

say:7:1520633007:1.text: There's also a mushroom growing here called the <style="highlight">petal umbrella</style> that causes hallucinations. Mix them with the spiky coconuts, and the hawk moth will be too dizzy to chase after us.
say:7:1520633007:1.source_cn: 这里还有一种叫<style=highlight>弥纹花...

say:9:1520633009:1.text: Okay, first we'll <style="highlight">look for the spiky coconuts and petal umbrellas</style> nearby. Then we need to figure out how to <style="highlight">reach the path under the log bridge</style> and cross from there.

choice:5:1:2.text: I can take it out before it spots us!
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 我可以在它发现之前解决它！
choice:5:1:2.male: I can take it out before it spots us!
choice:5:1:2.female: I can take it out before it spots us!

say:11:1520633005:0.text: No, trust me. Your eyesight is nowhere as sharp as theirs.
say:11:1520633005:0.source_cn: 不，相信我，你的视力远没有它好。

choice:5:2:3.text: I hate things that call for backup!
choice:5:2:3.source_cn: 最讨厌打架时呼朋唤友的家伙！
choice:5:2:3.male: I hate things that call for backup!
choice:5:2:3.female: I hate things that call for backup!
